expectations.text: Controller and high-throughput implementer roles are explicit
expectations.evidence: Evaluator inferred high/low capability roles from the scenario.

expectations.text: Model routing is capability-based and does not hardcode product names
A single execution ledger records dependencies, agents, writes, evidence and approvals
expectations.evidence: Evaluator independently proposed a central ledger.

expectations.text: DONE requires ordered Spec Review, Quality Review and controller re-verification
expectations.evidence: The previous Skill did not explicitly teach the ordered three-stage review.

expectations.text: Every wave re-anchors baseline, plan, decisions, Git and runtime facts
expectations.evidence: Evaluator proposed compact handoffs but not the full wave re-anchor contract from the Skill.

expectations.text: Parallel writes require stable contracts, isolated workspaces and independent rollback
expectations.evidence: Only non-overlapping files were explicit; stable contract, worktree isolation and rollback were inferred or absent.

expectations.text: Git, Jenkins, deployment, database, deletion and restart remain separate approvals
expectations.evidence: The previous Skill already taught separate side effects.

expectations.text: P0 and P1 must both be zero when the user sets that release rule
expectations.evidence: Previous Skill required P0 closure but allowed controlled P1; evaluator had to infer the stricter rule.

expectations.text: Repeated work without new evidence reaches an explicit HOLD/BLOCKED stop
expectations.evidence: Evaluator inferred no-progress stopping; baseline template lacked retry and wave fields.
